# GNK ASG — Pre-publication Background Test Report

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Test scope

This background test reviewed the preparation rules before the first public publication package is activated.

Checked files:

- brand hierarchy rules
- content quality gate
- web and mobile test matrix
- naming rules
- mobile quick actions plan
- dashboard wireframe
- editorial calendar

## Result summary

The preparation is suitable to continue, but the first public publication should not be activated until one final content package is reviewed on desktop and mobile.

## Passed checks

- Main story is defined as GNK ASG and GNK DINAMO Ltd.
- Personal layer is defined as accurate and discreet.
- Homepage should remain corporate and not become a personal landing page.
- Content quality gate exists.
- Mobile and desktop test matrix exists.
- Naming rules exist for URLs, images and video packages.
- Mobile quick actions are defined.
- Internal dashboard structure is defined.
- 30-day editorial calendar exists.

## Items to add before first public publication

### 1. First-publication fallback rule

If article, image, metadata, mobile view or links fail, the item must stay in preparation.

### 2. Preview review requirement

The first article must be reviewed in preview mode before it is linked publicly.

### 3. Canonical and share check

The canonical URL and share preview must be checked before external distribution.

### 4. Homepage restraint check

The first release must not overload the homepage. It may add a discreet latest insight card only after the article page itself is complete.

### 5. Dashboard truth rule

The dashboard must not show any module as active until the actual public result exists.

## Recommended next step

Prepare a single first-publication package:

- article title
- article text
- image concept
- meta description
- canonical URL
- short public post
- professional business post
- weekly video brief note
- mobile preview notes

Keep it unpublished until final review.

## Decision

Do not activate automatic publication yet. Continue with a controlled first publication package, then activate only after desktop and mobile review.
